gaps.title: Auditable multi-hop evidence selection
gaps.description: Long-video planners do not consistently expose an auditable chain from retrieved frames to final claims.

evidence_links.rationale: C1 shows that multi-hop planning exists, while provenance remains outside the reported mechanism.
C2 establishes auditability as a concrete capability that current planners should expose.

gaps.why_it_matters: A verifiable answer requires both correct retrieval and a traceable evidence path.
gaps.potential_direction: Jointly score retrieval utility and provenance completeness.

gaps.title: Adversarial evidence stress testing
gaps.description: Evidence selection methods lack systematic evaluation under misleading or incomplete retrieval paths.

evidence_links.rationale: C1 motivates testing whether multi-hop planning remains reliable when intermediate evidence is misleading.
C2 provides an auditability mechanism but does not constitute adversarial stress testing by itself.

gaps.why_it_matters: Unstressed retrieval chains can conceal brittle reasoning behavior.
gaps.potential_direction: Build adversarial query and evidence-corruption protocols.

gaps.title: Provenance-aware stopping criteria
gaps.description: Existing workflows do not clearly determine when accumulated evidence is sufficient to stop retrieval.

evidence_links.rationale: C1 supplies iterative retrieval behavior without an explicit provenance-completeness stopping rule.
C2 makes evidence auditability measurable and therefore exposes the missing stopping criterion.

gaps.why_it_matters: Stopping too early misses support, while stopping too late wastes the inference budget.
gaps.potential_direction: Stop when claim coverage and source diversity cross declared thresholds.
